packageRules.description: The plugin pins wrangler exactly, and a split leaves two wranglers in the tree. Major updates join this group rather than splitting off.

typescript-eslint declares a typescript peer range below 6.1.0 and throws on a TypeScript 7 tree, so typescript stays on 6.x. Drop this rule once typescript-eslint supports TypeScript 7: https://typescript-eslint.io/users/dependency-versions
